summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the new parent-notify feature set (Late Alerts, editable bilingual templates, Notify Log, shared ticks). 13/13 backend pytest cases pass; all frontend flows requested by main agent verified (template SAVE + persistence, notify log filters + search, muster banners w/ shared tick, coach access to /notify/log). No blocking issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/notify.py PUT /notify/templates does not persist deletion (only updates keys that are non-None). Acceptable given the 4 fixed keys with fallback to defaults, but a client can't ever revert a saved template back to default without hitting DB directly.
notify_log has no index on (date, reason, created_at) — fine for current scale (~62 members) but should be indexed if volumes grow.
GET /notify/log does not paginate beyond limit=1000; adequate for now.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@attendance.app / Admin@12345. Coach: coach.test@example.com / Exec@12345 (created via /api/members with category=coach if not present).
seed_data_creation: Coach user coach.test@example.com created (idempotently by test) with category=coach so /notify/log role gating for coach can be verified. Notify log rows for AJAY KANNE (father, absent) were used and additional 1 created by test_notify_parent_success_and_shows_in_today then left in place (still under 'today'). Templates modified with TESTMARK_ then restored to original.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/test_notify_parent.py covers: /muster/late-report, POST /notify/parent (400/404/success + shared-tick round-trip via /notify/today), GET /notify/log (admin+coach ok, filter, sort), GET/PUT /notify/templates (persistence + coach 403). Frontend spot-checked: /admin/notify-log filters+search, /admin/office WhatsApp Parent Messages panel save-and-reload, /muster absent + late banners, shared tick visible on AJAY KANNE father button (green ✓ state). wa.me popups were not clicked (expected — automation blocks them and product only flips tick when chat opens).
